gap: No result ChatGPT got states what the 13.3-inch Mobile Pixels Duex Plus DS costs at the maker's own US store today: the Duex DS Series listing starts at $183.99 (list $299.99), under the $195.49 (Best Buy) and $199.99 (B&H) cards ChatGPT showed, and the two older Trio models ChatGPT also recommended do not come up in that store's search.
standout_why: Compared against iTechGuides (cited in both chats), LBD Software (cited in chat 1) and Macworld (rank 1 in chat 1, not cited). iTechGuides names the Duex Plus DS for 'smaller 13- to 14-inch laptops' and the Duex Max DS for 'roughly 14 inches or larger' but gives no price for either. LBD Software lists eight Amazon-brand extenders with no prices at all. Macworld prices only 14-inch-and-up screens (Trio 3 Pro $499.99, Duex Float 2 Pro $299.99 when reviewed). TechPP (cited in chat 2) returned HTTP 403 and was not read. One caveat keeps this from a 3: the $183.99 is the listing's lowest price from the store's search, and the product page returned HTTP 429 on every attempt, so the variant was not opened. It is taken as the Plus DS because the series has two sizes and the Max DS is $215.99 in today's partner read. Re-read the variant before publishing.
decides: It confirms ChatGPT's pick and changes where to buy it. The Duex Plus DS is the only attach-to-lid screen here that a cited page places at 13 to 14 inches (iTechGuides' wording, not a Mobile Pixels page), and it is a variant of a Mobile Pixels listing we already link through cj:mobilepixels, so it can be the page's winner with a new product record at the store price. Our Duex Max DS ($215.99, 14.1-inch) loses on size: iTechGuides puts it at roughly 14 inches or larger, and it costs $32.00 more than the series' starting price. Skip risk: the page needs two of our rows whose maker states a 13-inch fit, and today only the FOPO S788 (12–18.5-inch, FOPO's range, from the brief) has that. The FOPO S1 and S7 fit ranges could not be read, and Mobile Pixels' own range for the Trio 3 Pro is 15–16 inches.

findings.label: Maker's US store price (Duex DS Series listing, lowest variant)
findings.note: Read through storecheck.py search on mobilepixels.us (the store's own search), which returns the listing's lowest variant price. The product page gave HTTP 429 on four tries, so the variant itself was not opened. The listing states two sizes, 13.3-inch (Duex Plus DS) and 14.1-inch (Duex Max DS); the Max DS is $215.99 in the brief's partner read of 2026-11-21, so $183.99 is taken as the Plus DS. Black Friday sale price, no code. Confirm variant and variant id before adding a record.

findings.label: Price gap against the retailers ChatGPT showed
findings.note: 195.49 − 183.99 = 11.50; 199.99 − 183.99 = 16.00. The retailer prices are the card prices in the two saved chats (2026-11-22T02:25Z and 03:23Z). B&H's page returned HTTP 403 and Best Buy's was not opened, so the retailer figures are ChatGPT's, not re-read.

findings.note: Listing overview text returned by the store search. It does not use the words DisplayPort Alt Mode; one added screen, so one video-capable USB-C port (or HDMI plus USB power) is what it needs.

findings.source_title: 15 Best Laptop Screen Extenders for 2026: USB-C, Portable & Triple-Screen Picks

findings.source_title: 15 Best Laptop Screen Extenders for 2026: USB-C, Portable & Triple-Screen Picks

findings.value: Macsecor: two 14-inch, 13–17.3-inch fit, 2.3 lb. Vixtan: 13–17.3-inch fit, 3.0 lb, $170.95 on iTechGuides. ZUMWALT P7: two 15.6-inch, 13–17.3-inch fit

Each adds two screens ('triple' here means two added), so each needs two video outputs. iTechGuides notes for the 15.6-inch listing that M1/M2/M3 MacBooks need an extra cable and a driver.

Duex Plus DS weight and Mobile Pixels' own laptop fit range. ChatGPT says about 1.3 lb. A search summary said the 2023 manual lists 1.8 lb and a Lowe's-hosted sheet 675 g, but the manual PDF (cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1705/7751/files/English_Duex_Plus_DS-manual_2023-V1.pdf) downloaded as unreadable binary and the text extraction was not permitted. This is worth a re-read: if the maker's manual says 1.8 lb, ChatGPT's weight claim is wrong and the pick fails its own 'under 1.5 lb' line.

SideTrak Swivel 12.5-inch price, fit range and video path: sidetrak.com returned HTTP 502 (store search and product page) and B&H returned 403. ChatGPT's card says $149.99 at Target; a search summary showed $279.99 at Best Buy and Walmart; neither was opened.
